requirements.reason: Initial quasi-static proxy conditions, not manufacturer operating speeds or verified material properties. This is not a manufacturer tolerance.

T-CASE-0.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-CASE-1.action: Apply aspiration;release;press dispense below then above threshold;repeat low/high wheel positions.
T-CASE-1.observable: Independent pump direction,off state and command ordering.
T-CASE-1.pass_condition: Aspirate commands inward;released is off;light dispense has pump off;strong dispense outward;higher wheel setting never lowers command.
T-CASE-1.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-CASE-2.initial: Large opening of silicone mount down;reference10 mL pipet inserted.
T-CASE-2.action: Lift20 mm and hold5 s;inspect lumen through filter housing.
T-CASE-2.pass_condition: Pipet retained with <=1 mm drift;filter spans intended route;no bypass cavity or unintended overlap >0.2 mm.
T-CASE-2.note: Proxy acceptance conditions,not manufacturer tolerances; source requirements retain their own provenance.

T-LOAD.condition: No errors, resources resolved and all states finite.
